**Generated by `run_recovery_reassert.py`. Do not edit — re-run it.** Every number below is read out of `logs/` by that script; nothing here is transcribed by hand.

Diagnosis of the two *incidental* numbers that moved between `../records/20260801-233807-32fbaa0.md` (schematic) and `../records/20260811-065930-35a87a6.md` (extracted): the `t_reassert_us` slip and the `ss_-40c_2.97v` ERROR. ## Where the decision is lost

All times are µs after the dip starts (20 ms). The dip floor is held 20.001–20.051 ms and the rail is fully recovered at 20.052 ms, so anything past **+52 µs** is a recovery-edge event, not a response to the dip.

`por_output_chain`'s measured deglitch dwell at the cell level is **1.86–8.88 µs** with idealised bias (`sim/por-output-chain-deglitch/`, `design/por_output_chain.md`) — the yardstick the `POR_RAW` pulse width column is read against. A `POR_RAW` pulse narrower than the dwell is filtered by design; one wider than it is not.
